data.cause: The internet is down because of a provider-side fault: the cable link dropped at 02:01:44 ("No Ranging Response received - T3 time-out") and during re-registration the modem could not fetch its DOCSIS configuration file ("TFTP failed - configuration file NOT FOUND"); although the modem later reported registration complete (~02:28), the ISP handoff at 198.51.100.1 does not respond, so traffic never reaches the internet even after WAN reloads.
evidence: Modem event log shows the outage origin: 'No Ranging Response received - T3 time-out' at 02:01:44 and 'TFTP failed - configuration file NOT FOUND' at 02:14:10 (cat /var/db/wan-watchdog/modem-events.jsonl)

At 02:06 the watchdog recorded cm_status NOT_SYNCHRONIZED; the modem only became OPERATIONAL around 02:28-02:29, yet connectivity did not recover (cat /var/db/wan-watchdog/events.jsonl, modem-metrics.jsonl)

gw.lan holds a valid DHCP lease (fixed-address 198.51.100.27, expires 2026/3/6) with router 198.51.100.1 installed as default route via vtnet0 — local WAN config is intact (cat /var/db/dhclient.leases.vtnet0; netstat -rn)
vtnet0 is UP/RUNNING/LOWER_UP with carrier (ifconfig vtnet0), so the physical link to the CPE is fine
ping -c 3 -n 198.51.100.1: 100% packet loss — the ISP-side gateway/CPE does not respond even after the modem re-registered

The watchdog already decided to reload and two WAN reloads occurred during this outage (state.json: reloads_in_outage: 2, last_action: reload), which did not restore service — ruling out a stale local lease as the cause
data.recommendation: Contact the ISP: report that the cable modem dropped upstream sync at 02:01 and failed to retrieve its provisioning/config file (TFTP NOT FOUND) during re-registration, and that the handoff gateway 198.51.100.1 still does not respond despite the modem showing OPERATIONAL and two WAN DHCP reloads on the firewall. Local config (lease, route, interface) is healthy, so the fix is on the provider side; a further wan_reload or modem_reboot is unlikely to help since reloads already ran without effect.
